main_point.en: We can trust the One who has all authority.
main_point.zh-Hant: 我們可以信靠擁有一切權柄的那一位。

christ_connection.en: When Jesus approached the man who was possessed by demons, even the demons recognized His authority. Jesus would later demonstrate His authority over sin and evil in a greater way through His crucifixion and resurrection. Sin no longer has power over those who trust in Jesus.
christ_connection.zh-Hant: 當耶穌走近被鬼附的人時，連鬼也認出祂的權柄。後來，耶穌藉著受死和復活，更充分地彰顯了祂勝過罪與邪惡的權柄。罪不再轄制信靠耶穌的人。

title.zh-Hant: 耶穌有勝過邪惡的權柄

content.en:
21 And they went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath he entered the synagogue and was teaching. 
22 And they were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as one who had authority, and not as the scribes. 
23 And immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit. And he cried out, 
24 “What have you to do with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God.” 
25 But Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him!” 
26 And the unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying out with a loud voice, came out of him. 
27 And they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching with authority! He commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him.” 
28 And at once his fame spread everywhere throughout all the surrounding region of Galilee.
content.zh-Hant:
21 到了迦百農，耶穌就在安息日進了會堂教訓人。
22 眾人很希奇他的教訓；因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像文士。
23 在會堂裏，有一個人被污鬼附著。他喊叫說：
24 「拿撒勒人耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，乃是神的聖者。」
25 耶穌責備他說：「不要作聲！從這人身上出來吧。」
26 污鬼叫那人抽了一陣瘋，大聲喊叫，就出來了。
27 眾人都驚訝，以致彼此對問說：「這是甚麼事？是個新道理啊！他用權柄吩咐污鬼，連污鬼也聽從了他。」
28 耶穌的名聲就傳遍了加利利的四方。

title.zh-Hant: 耶穌有勝過疾病的權柄

content.en:
29 And immediately he left the synagogue and entered the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John. 
30 Now Simon’s mother-in-law lay ill with a fever, and immediately they told him about her. 
31 And he came and took her by the hand and lifted her up, and the fever left her, and she began to serve them. 
32 That evening at sundown they brought to him all who were sick or oppressed by demons. 
33 And the whole city was gathered together at the door. 
34 And he healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. And he would not permit the demons to speak, because they knew him.
content.zh-Hant:
29 他們一出會堂，就同著雅各、約翰，進了西門和安得烈的家。
30 西門的岳母正害熱病躺著，就有人告訴耶穌。
31 耶穌進前拉著她的手，扶她起來，熱就退了，她就服事他們。
32 天晚日落的時候，有人帶著一切害病的，和被鬼附的，來到耶穌跟前。
33 合城的人都聚集在門前。
34 耶穌治好了許多害各樣病的人，又趕出許多鬼，不許鬼說話，因為鬼認識他。

content.en: Leaders: We can’t deny the darkness in our world, but Jesus maintains control—the Light that darkness will never overcome (John 1:5).
content.zh-Hant: 帶領者：我們無法否認世界上的黑暗，但耶穌仍掌管一切；祂是黑暗永遠不能勝過的光（約1:5）。

title.zh-Hant: 耶穌有勝過邪惡的權柄

content.en: “At first glance, the statement that he taught with authority might be taken as a description of his style. It could be a way of saying that Jesus was a dynamic and compelling speaker. As the story unfolds, though, it is not the way he spoke that is important; it is what happens when he taught. In this instance his presence provoked a confrontation with the demonic. Jesus cast the evil spirit out, and with an appalling convulsion the evil spirit obeyed him. After the exorcism Mark repeats the reference to Jesus’s amazing authority. Jesus’s teaching was much more than a collection of novel or encouraging ideas. It was an exercise of power. The powers of darkness perceived in his teaching a challenge to their dominion. The authority of Jesus was displayed as those powers were first silenced and then banished.”¹⁰
content.zh-Hant: 「乍看之下，祂教訓人有權柄，似乎是在形容祂的風格，可能是說耶穌是一位充滿活力、能打動人心的講者。然而，隨著故事展開，重要的不是祂說話的方式，而是祂教導時發生的事。在這裏，祂的出現引發了與邪靈的衝突。耶穌趕出污鬼，污鬼使人猛烈抽搐，然後順服了祂。趕鬼之後，馬可再次提到耶穌令人驚奇的權柄。耶穌的教導遠不只是一些新穎或鼓舞人心的觀念，而是權能的施展。黑暗勢力察覺祂的教導挑戰了牠們的統治。當這些勢力先被制止發聲，然後被驅逐時，耶穌的權柄便顯明出來。」¹⁰

content.en: “The word usually translated ‘scribes’ is found twenty-one times in Mark and is regularly translated ‘teachers of the law’ by the NIV. They were not copyists but scholars and therefore experts in the interpretation of the law. Their interpretations, which in the time of Jesus existed only in oral form and are therefore called the oral tradition (7:5-13), constituted a second law that came to be as important as the written, or Mosaic, law.”¹¹
content.zh-Hant: 「馬可福音中通常譯為『文士』的詞出現了二十一次，NIV經常將它譯為『律法教師』。他們不是抄寫員，而是學者，因此是解釋律法的專家。在耶穌的時代，他們的解釋只以口傳形式存在，因此被稱為口傳傳統（7:5-13）。這些解釋構成了第二套律法，其重要性逐漸與成文的摩西律法相當。」¹¹

title.zh-Hant: 耶穌有勝過疾病的權柄

content.en: “Verse 31 suggests the quickness and completeness of the cure. The mother-in-law is presented simply as a model of discipleship, which requires lowly service from all, male and female. By including accounts of the healing of women as well as men, Mark implied that Jesus was concerned about all people, including those who had a lowly place in society.”¹²
content.zh-Hant: 「第31節顯示這次醫治迅速而徹底。這位岳母被呈現為門徒的榜樣：無論男女，作門徒都需要謙卑服事。馬可記載了女性和男性得醫治的事，暗示耶穌關心所有人，包括社會地位低微的人。」¹²

content.en: Some of the most intriguing and mysterious topics in Christian theology relate to the spiritual realm and spiritual warfare. Unfortunately, movies and books influence our views on the supernatural instead of the Bible. Demons have no authority to kill or possess Christians, but they can wage war against us. The enemy harasses believers with accusatory thoughts and lies to discourage, scare, or intimidate us (John 8:44; Rev. 12:10). We must be defensive against these schemes. Scripture promises that if we resist the devil, he will flee from us (James 4:7). We must firmly reject the lies of the enemy and replace them with the truth of God’s Word. Scripture warns that we must not give the enemy a foothold through ongoing sin in our lives (Eph. 4:27). Scripture forbids Christians from engaging with any kind of divination, witchcraft, or attempts to communicate with the dead (Deut. 18:10-11; Acts 16:16). We don’t have to live in fear of the enemy because Jesus has authority over these powers, and He delegates this authority to us as believers. Jesus displayed His power to cast out demons and heal the sick. Jesus’s ability to set people free from demonization baffled Jewish leadership, who accused Him of being possessed by the devil Mark 3:22)! Jesus’s miracles are a glimpse of what is to come in the end: He will cast Satan and his demons into the lake of fire forever.
content.zh-Hant: 基督教神學中一些最引人入勝、最神祕的主題與屬靈領域和屬靈爭戰有關。可惜的是，電影和書籍往往取代聖經，影響我們對超自然事物的看法。鬼無權殺害基督徒或附在他們身上，但牠們可以攻擊我們。仇敵以控告的意念和謊言騷擾信徒，使我們灰心、害怕或受威嚇（約8:44；啟12:10）。我們必須防備這些詭計。聖經應許，只要我們抵擋魔鬼，魔鬼就會逃跑（雅4:7）。我們必須堅決拒絕仇敵的謊言，並以神話語的真理取代。聖經警告我們，不可因持續活在罪中而給仇敵留地步（弗4:27）。聖經禁止基督徒參與任何形式的占卜、巫術或試圖與死人溝通（申18:10-11；徒16:16）。我們不必懼怕仇敵，因為耶穌有勝過這些勢力的權柄，並把這權柄交給我們信徒。耶穌彰顯了祂趕鬼和醫病的能力。耶穌釋放被鬼轄制之人的能力令猶太領袖困惑，他們反而指控祂被魔鬼附著（可3:22）！耶穌的神蹟讓我們一瞥最終將發生的事：祂會把撒但和牠的鬼永遠扔進火湖。

content.en: Demons are angelic beings who sinned against God and continually do evil work in the world today (Job 1:6; Zech. 3:1; Luke 10:18). Demons oppose God and seek to destroy His work, as seen in the Bible’s description of Satan, the head of demons, who seeks to steal, kill, and destroy. Though demons have power, they are limited by God’s control and can only act within the constraints of what God permits. In the end, all of the demons will be cast into the lake of fire, for which it was originally created.
content.zh-Hant: 鬼魔是得罪神的天使，至今仍不斷在世上作惡（伯1:6；亞3:1；路10:18）。鬼魔敵擋神，試圖破壞祂的工作；聖經形容鬼魔的首領撒但，企圖偷竊、殺害和毀壞。鬼魔雖有能力，卻受神的掌管限制，只能在神容許的範圍內行動。最終，所有鬼魔都將被扔進火湖；火湖原本就是為牠們預備的。

content.en: LORD, WE PRAISE YOU FOR YOUR POWER AND STRENGTH. ALL POWER AND AUTHORITY OVER HEAVEN AND EARTH BELONG TO YOU. HELP US NOT TO FEAR THE ENEMY. GIVE US STRENGTH TO WALK IN VICTORY, KNOWING THAT YOU HAVE WON THE BATTLE OVER DEATH AND DARKNESS.
content.zh-Hant: 主啊，我們讚美祢的大能和力量。天上地下所有的能力和權柄都屬於祢。求祢幫助我們不懼怕仇敵，賜我們力量過得勝的生活，知道祢已經戰勝死亡和黑暗。

question.en: Let’s check in on how you’re doing spiritually. Last week, we discussed that Christ followers can expect to face rejection in our world because the world is opposed to God. Have you experienced or seen any instances of rejection in the past week? Did you avoid rejection by giving in to popular opinion? Did you stand? How did you feel after?
question.zh-Hant: 讓我們看看你的屬靈狀況。上週我們討論過，由於世界敵擋神，基督的跟隨者在世上可能遭到拒絕。過去一週，你有經歷或看見任何遭拒絕的情況嗎？你是否因迎合大眾意見而避免了被拒絕？你有堅守立場嗎？之後你有甚麼感受？

instructions.en:
These optional activities are designed to help your students interact. You'll find a Discussion Activity and a Cultural Connection, which touches on a relevant topic in today’s teen culture. Each group is different, so adapt these activities to fit your group’s needs. The goal is for students to connect more to the lesson as they connect to the topic and to one another.

Ask the following questions, allowing time for students to share responses:
instructions.zh-Hant:
這些可自由選用的活動旨在幫助學生彼此互動。當中有討論活動及文化連結，後者涉及當今青少年文化中的相關話題。每個小組都不同，請按小組需要調整活動。目的是讓學生透過討論話題和彼此交流，更投入課程。

請提出以下問題，並給學生時間分享答案：

question.en: In your daily life, which people have the greatest authority over you?
question.zh-Hant: 在日常生活中，哪些人對你有最大的權柄？

question.en: If you could be in a position of authority, what role would you choose?
question.zh-Hant: 如果你可以擔任有權柄的職位，你會選擇甚麼角色？

question.en: What makes someone a good authority figure versus a bad one?
question.zh-Hant: 好的掌權者和壞的掌權者有甚麼分別？

content.en: When we think of what makes someone a good authority figure, we likely picture someone who is strong and caring, someone who has integrity and is committed to doing what is right. Thankfully, Jesus is all of this and more. In the Gospels, Jesus demonstrated His divine authority over heaven and earth. He displayed His authority over sickness and the powers of evil by healing the sick and freeing those in demonic bondage, as we’ll see in today’s passage.
content.zh-Hant: 想到好的掌權者時，我們可能會想到既堅強又關懷人、有正直品格並致力行正確之事的人。感謝主，耶穌具備這一切，而且遠超過這些。在福音書中，耶穌彰顯了祂掌管天地的神聖權柄。正如我們今天的經文所見，祂藉著醫治病人和釋放被鬼轄制的人，彰顯祂勝過疾病和邪惡勢力的權柄。

cultural_connection.en: Culture is fascinated by the spiritual realm, often manifesting as a dangerous interest in darkness and evil. Movies, shows, and books with demonic themes top the charts. You may wonder if taking part in darkness is a big deal for believers. What if it’s just for fun? Where is the line? First, we can’t let the world define this line. We must confront the idea of believers turning to content with demonic forces for entertainment—media that profits off real powers of evil, whose goal is to steal, kill, and destroy (John 10:10). Even more dangerous, consuming dark content can open doors to demonic attack in the life of a Christian. Scripture forbids us from engaging with Ouija boards, tarot cards, psychics or mediums, or participating in attempts to contact the dead (Deut. 18:10-11; Acts 16:16)—even in the name of “fun” or “pretending.” We shouldn’t open any doors to darkness. Why would we even want to associate with the powers of evil, who are completely at odds with God’s work and who seek to destroy His work in us?
cultural_connection.zh-Hant: 現今文化對屬靈領域十分著迷，常表現為對黑暗和邪惡的危險興趣。以鬼魔為主題的電影、節目和書籍大受歡迎。你可能會問，信徒參與黑暗的事真的那麼嚴重嗎？如果只是為了好玩呢？界線在哪裏？首先，我們不能讓世界替我們劃定界線。我們必須正視信徒把含有鬼魔勢力的內容當作娛樂的觀念；這類媒體利用真實的邪惡勢力牟利，而這些勢力的目的是偷竊、殺害和毀壞（約10:10）。更危險的是，接觸黑暗內容可能為鬼魔攻擊基督徒的生活打開大門。聖經禁止我們接觸通靈板、塔羅牌、靈媒，或試圖聯絡死人（申18:10-11；徒16:16），即使以『好玩』或『假裝』為名也不可以。我們不應向黑暗打開任何門。我們為甚麼要與完全敵擋神的工作、企圖破壞祂在我們身上工作的邪惡勢力有任何關聯呢？

title.zh-Hant: 耶穌有勝過邪惡的權柄

question.en: How did the people react when Jesus cast out the unclean spirit? Why did they respond this way?
question.zh-Hant: 耶穌趕出污鬼時，眾人有甚麼反應？他們為甚麼這樣反應？

answer.en: The people were astonished by what they saw, amazed by Jesus’s authority to command unclean spirits to do as He said. Jesus did not have to perform a complicated ritual or beg the demon to leave. He did not have to recruit a special rabbi for the task. Jesus simply told the spirit to be silent and come out of the man, and it did. Jesus had complete control of the situation and amazed those who were watching with His remarkable power—the Word (John 1:1), healing and restoring by the power of His spoken word.
answer.zh-Hant: 眾人對所見的事感到驚訝，耶穌有權柄吩咐污鬼，污鬼就照祂所說的去做，令他們十分驚奇。耶穌不必舉行複雜的儀式，也不必懇求鬼離開，更不必找一位特別的拉比來做這事。耶穌只吩咐污鬼安靜，從那人身上出來，污鬼就出來了。耶穌完全掌管局面，祂非凡的能力令旁觀的人驚奇；祂是道（約1:1），藉著祂所說之話的能力醫治和復原人。

question.en: What does the unclean spirit know about Jesus? What does this show us about knowing versus following?
question.zh-Hant: 污鬼知道耶穌的甚麼身分？這顯明知道與跟隨有甚麼分別？

answer.en: The unclean spirit recognized Jesus and called Him the “Holy One of God” (v. 24). Unclean spirits, or demons, are ancient spiritual beings who rebelled against God and actively work against Him. They strive to “steal and kill and destroy” (John 10:10). God is far more powerful than Satan and his demons; they are limited by God’s control and are subject to His will. The demons know Jesus is who He says He is, and they know His aim is to destroy them. In the end, every force of evil will be destroyed and under God’s judgment forever.
answer.zh-Hant: 污鬼認出耶穌，稱祂為『神的聖者』（24節）。污鬼，也就是鬼魔，是古老的靈體；牠們悖逆神，並積極敵擋祂。牠們企圖『偷竊，殺害，毀壞』（約10:10）。神比撒但和牠的鬼魔強大得多；牠們受神掌管，必須服從祂的旨意。鬼魔知道耶穌就是祂所宣告的那一位，也知道祂要毀滅牠們。最終，一切邪惡勢力都要被毀滅，永遠處於神的審判之下。

question.en: What kind of spiritual battles or spiritual darkness do we face? How can knowing that Jesus has all authority over the powers of darkness help us fight?
question.zh-Hant: 我們面對哪些屬靈爭戰或屬靈黑暗？知道耶穌有勝過一切黑暗勢力的權柄，如何幫助我們爭戰？

answer.en: As believers, we don’t always recognize the spiritual battle raging around us. We are actively fighting against darkness here and now. The enemy attacks us when we’re vulnerable—when we stop dwelling on the truth of God’s Word, on what is good and pure (Phil. 4:8). We battle sinful thoughts and emotions, old habits, and temptation. But as Christians, we are on the side of victory; Jesus has won the war against all evil powers! Jesus has disarmed the forces of darkness, and He made a public display of them by triumphing over them on the cross (Col. 2:14-15). Satan and his demons are literally losers—they have lost the war that Jesus has won. When we are in Christ, Jesus gives us His authority over all the powers of darkness. We don’t have to live in fear of what Jesus has defeated. Why? Because the One who lives within us—the Holy Spirit—is so much greater than the enemy who temporarily rules the world (1 John 4:4). On our own, we can never have victory, but because of Jesus, we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us, and no force of evil can separate us from the love of God (Rom. 8:37-39).
answer.zh-Hant: 作為信徒，我們並不總能察覺周圍激烈的屬靈爭戰。我們此時此地正與黑暗爭戰。當我們軟弱、不再思想神話語的真理和良善純潔的事時，仇敵便攻擊我們（腓4:8）。我們與犯罪的意念和情緒、舊習慣及試探爭戰。但基督徒站在得勝的一方；耶穌已經勝過一切邪惡勢力！耶穌解除黑暗勢力的武裝，藉著十字架勝過牠們，公開顯明祂的勝利（西2:14-15）。撒但和牠的鬼魔確實是失敗者；牠們已輸掉耶穌所贏得的爭戰。在基督裏，耶穌賜給我們勝過一切黑暗勢力的權柄。我們不必懼怕耶穌已經擊敗的仇敵。為甚麼？因為住在我們裏面的聖靈，遠比暫時掌管世界的仇敵更大（約壹4:4）。靠自己，我們永遠不能得勝；但因著耶穌，我們藉著愛我們的主得勝有餘，沒有任何邪惡勢力能使我們與神的愛隔絕（羅8:37-39）。

title.zh-Hant: 耶穌有勝過疾病的權柄

question.en: What stands out to you about the way Jesus healed Simon’s mother-in-law?
question.zh-Hant: 耶穌醫治西門岳母的方式，有甚麼令你特別留意？

answer.en: When Jesus entered the house, the disciples told Him that Simon’s mother-in-law was sick with a fever. A fever indicates an illness or infection, and in the days before modern antibiotics, this woman’s situation could have been deadly. Jesus tenderly took her by the hand and raised her up, and the fever left her immediately. His touch alone brought healing to her body, displaying Jesus’s amazing power to heal and His gentle compassion toward the sick. Sometimes, we see Jesus’s power and fail to remember that He is also incredibly gentle and kind. We can have hope that Jesus will also minister to our hearts and bodies with care.
answer.zh-Hant: 耶穌進屋時，門徒告訴祂西門的岳母發燒生病了。發燒表示患病或感染，在現代抗生素出現以前，這位婦人的情況可能致命。耶穌溫柔地拉著她的手，扶她起來，她立刻退了燒。祂的觸摸便醫治了她的身體，彰顯耶穌驚人的醫治能力，以及祂對病人的溫柔憐憫。有時我們看到耶穌的大能，卻忘記祂也極其溫柔仁慈。我們可以存盼望，相信耶穌也會細心照顧我們的身心。

question.en: Why do you think Jesus told the demons to keep silent about Him?
question.zh-Hant: 你認為耶穌為甚麼吩咐鬼不要說出祂的身分？

answer.en: We are quick to shout our achievements on social media, but Jesus wasn’t concerned with attention. Jesus performed many signs and miracles to show that He was the Messiah and to demonstrate His compassion for all people. However, Jesus was on a specific mission from God—a mission with a timeline and a purpose. Any information or news about Jesus coming from a demonic source would not be trustworthy, since demons are liars who try to keep people away from God. Jesus followed God’s plan for when and where He would reveal His identity, and evil forces had no authority to challenge God’s timing.
answer.zh-Hant: 我們很容易急於在社交媒體上宣揚自己的成就，但耶穌並不追求關注。耶穌行了許多神蹟奇事，顯明祂是彌賽亞，也彰顯祂對眾人的憐憫。然而，耶穌領受了神交付的特定使命，有其時間和目的。鬼魔說謊，企圖使人遠離神，所以任何來自鬼魔、關於耶穌的消息都不可信。耶穌按照神的計劃，在指定的時間和地點顯明自己的身分；邪惡勢力無權挑戰神的時間安排。

question.en: How did Jesus’s ability to heal the sick and cast out demons foreshadow what He would accomplish on the cross?
question.zh-Hant: 耶穌醫病趕鬼的能力，如何預示祂將在十字架上成就的事？

answer.en: Healing the sick and driving out demons are both pretty amazing, but they pale in comparison to what Jesus accomplished in His death and resurrection. Jesus displayed that He has power not only over sickness but over death itself. The result of sin is death, but Jesus defeated death by His resurrection. He promised that all who believe in Him will have eternal life (John 11:25). Jesus’s death also destroyed the one holding the power of death, the devil (Heb. 2:14-15), sealing Satan’s fate with finality. Sin and evil are defeated, and Jesus shares His victory with us both now and forever!
answer.zh-Hant: 醫病和趕鬼都令人驚嘆，但與耶穌藉著受死和復活所成就的相比，便顯得微不足道。耶穌顯明祂不但有勝過疾病的能力，也有勝過死亡的能力。罪的結果是死亡，但耶穌藉著復活戰勝死亡。祂應許，所有信祂的人都會得永生（約11:25）。耶穌的死也摧毀了那掌死權的魔鬼（來2:14-15），徹底確定撒但的結局。罪惡已被擊敗，耶穌與我們分享祂的得勝，直到永遠！

question.en: What did Simon’s mother-in-law do immediately after Jesus healed her? Why don’t we always respond in this way?
question.zh-Hant: 西門的岳母得耶穌醫治後，立刻做了甚麼？為甚麼我們不總是這樣回應？

answer.en: After Simon’s mother-in-law was healed, she immediately began to serve Jesus. We should also respond to Jesus’s healing and forgiveness in our lives with obedient service. Unfortunately, we don’t always respond this way. We are quick to forget what God healed us from: sin, spiritual death, and eternal separation from Him. We often revert to our old habits of serving ourselves instead of serving the One who has saved us. Reminding ourselves of what Jesus has done for us motivates us to live in service to Him. We serve Jesus as a response to who He is and what He has done for us—we love Him because He first loved us (1 John 4:19). He has freely saved us by His grace and has created us in Christ to do good works (Eph. 2:8-10). We should consistently remind ourselves that serving the One who freely gave His life for us is the greatest honor of our lives.
answer.zh-Hant: 西門的岳母得醫治後，立刻開始服事耶穌。我們也應以順服的服事來回應耶穌在我們生命中的醫治和赦免。可惜我們並不總是這樣回應。我們很快就忘記神醫治我們脫離了甚麼：罪、屬靈的死亡和與祂永遠隔絕。我們常回到服事自己的舊習慣，而不是服事拯救我們的主。提醒自己耶穌為我們所做的事，會激勵我們一生服事祂。我們服事耶穌，是回應祂的身分和祂為我們所做的一切；我們愛祂，因為祂先愛我們（約壹4:19）。祂憑恩典白白拯救我們，並在基督裏創造我們，為要叫我們行善（弗2:8-10）。我們應不斷提醒自己：服事那位甘心為我們捨命的主，是一生中最大的榮幸。

content.en:
Can you name your favorite influencer or celebrity? How well would you say that you know them? The truth is that you don’t actually know this person; you only know facts about them. You're not actually friends with them, right? You knowing about someone does not mean you know them. Contrast that with what you know about your best friend. You actually know them because you have a friendship with them. You have head knowledge about your favorite influencer; you have heart knowledge of your best friend.

Today’s passage points out that head knowledge of God (like the demons who know about God and shudder) isn’t enough. The demons believe God is real, but they aren’t surrendered to Him. Heart knowledge comes from surrendering to the Lord and allowing the Holy Spirit to transform us. How do we know the difference? Well, it’s the difference between works only without faith) and works that flow from faith. Head knowledge looks like showing up to church on Sunday but telling dirty jokes at school on Monday. Heart knowledge looks like showing up to church on Sunday and then intentionally not telling a lie because you want to honor God with your words and actions. Heart knowledge is being convicted when you do slip up and repenting of your sin. The motivation to honor God is not rooted in a desire to be a “good Christian” but in knowing your heavenly Father is grieved when you sin. And you don’t want to grieve Him. When you know God, the Word of God and the Holy Spirit will work within you to produce spiritual fruit in your life (Gal. 5:22-23)—proof of heart transformation instead of head knowledge, faith plus works. A relationship with Jesus—knowing Him—changes us from the inside out.
content.zh-Hant:
你能說出最喜歡的網紅或名人嗎？你認為自己有多了解他們？事實是，你並不真正認識這個人，只是知道一些關於他們的事。你們並非真正的朋友，對嗎？知道某人的事，不等於認識那個人。把這與你對最好朋友的認識相比：你真正認識朋友，因為你們有友誼。你對最喜歡的網紅只有頭腦上的認識，對最好朋友卻有內心的認識。

今天的經文指出，單憑頭腦認識神並不足夠，就像鬼魔知道神並且戰兢。鬼魔相信神真實存在，卻沒有降服於祂。內心的認識來自向主降服，讓聖靈改變我們。我們怎樣分辨兩者？分別就在於沒有信心、只有行為，和從信心流露的行為。頭腦上的認識，可能是星期日去教會，星期一卻在學校說下流笑話。內心的認識，則可能是星期日去教會，星期一刻意不說謊，因為你想用言語和行為尊榮神。內心的認識，也是在犯錯時感到責備，並為罪悔改。尊榮神的動機不是想做個『好基督徒』，而是知道犯罪會使天父憂傷，而你不想令祂憂傷。當你認識神，神的話語和聖靈會在你裏面工作，使你的生命結出屬靈果子（加5:22-23）。這證明你不僅有頭腦上的知識，心也被改變，有信心也有行為。與耶穌建立關係、認識祂，會使我們由內而外改變。

question.en: Does your life show evidence that you have heart knowledge of God? How?
question.zh-Hant: 你的生命有顯明你從心裏認識神嗎？如何顯明？

question.en: Read Galatians 5:22-23. Which characteristic is the hardest for you to show in your life and why?
question.zh-Hant: 閱讀加拉太書5:22-23。哪一種品格最難在你的生命中表現出來？為甚麼？

prayer.en: Thank You, God, for Your transforming power in my life. Please help me to get to know You in a deeper way today.
prayer.zh-Hant: 神啊，感謝祢在我生命中施行改變的大能。求祢幫助我今天更深地認識祢。

content.en:
The demon quickly submitted to Jesus and obeyed. Read that again. The presence of evil knew who Jesus was and obeyed Him. Think about it: A demon submitted to Jesus’s authority, yet as followers, we often resist obeying Him! How quickly do you obey Jesus? When you feel the Holy Spirit urging you to sit with someone who has no friends at lunch, do you obey? When your parents tell you to stay home for the night, how do you respond? If you have a hidden sin, are you holding it close because you enjoy it?

As followers of Jesus, we must quickly follow His commands. Proverbs 4:23 encourages us to guard our hearts because everything we do flows from the heart. This means that when sin creeps in, you repent and turn from it before you get comfortable with it—because that’s what happens, right? The first time we give in to temptation, we feel uncomfortable. But the more we give in, the more accepting we become of our sin—the more we justify the sin as not being a “big deal.” When you feel the prompting to talk with someone outside of your circle, you obey. When your parents give you a directive that you don’t appreciate, react out of respect because it honors God and them. We can’t be slow to obey God. Paul reminds us that we should not continue to sin just because we know God is gracious and asks, “How can we who died to sin still live in it?” (Rom. 6:1-2). Think about it: Why would you overcome sin and then invite it back into your life? Jesus’s power is greater than the darkness around us, so don’t join it; instead, quickly surrender to His commands and live in the power and peace that He gives.
content.zh-Hant:
鬼很快就順服耶穌，聽從祂。再讀一次：邪惡的靈知道耶穌是誰，並且聽從祂。想一想：一隻鬼尚且順服耶穌的權柄，我們作跟隨者的卻常常抗拒順服祂！你順服耶穌有多快？當你感到聖靈催促你午餐時與一位沒有朋友的人同坐，你會順服嗎？父母叫你晚上留在家裏時，你會怎樣回應？如果你有隱藏的罪，是否因為喜歡而緊抓不放？

作耶穌的跟隨者，我們必須迅速遵行祂的命令。箴言4:23勉勵我們保守自己的心，因為我們所做的一切都由心發出。這表示當罪悄悄進來，要在習慣它之前悔改離開；因為我們不就是這樣嗎？第一次屈服於試探時，我們會感到不安。但屈服得越多，就越接受自己的罪，越替罪辯解，說它『沒甚麼大不了』。當你感到催促，要與圈子以外的人交談時，就順服吧。父母給你不喜歡的指示時，要以尊重回應，因為這是尊榮神和他們。我們不可遲遲不順服神。保羅提醒我們，不應因知道神有恩典就繼續犯罪，並問：『我們在罪上死了的人豈可仍在罪中活著呢？』（羅6:1-2）想想看：既然已勝過罪，為甚麼又要邀請它回到生命中？耶穌的能力比我們周圍的黑暗更大，所以不要加入黑暗；要迅速順服祂的命令，活在祂所賜的能力和平安中。

question.en: Do you quickly obey God? Why or why not?
question.zh-Hant: 你會迅速順服神嗎？為甚麼？

question.en: In what ways are you guarding your heart? In what ways are you leaving it open to attack?
question.zh-Hant: 你在哪些方面保守自己的心？又在哪些方面讓它容易受攻擊？

prayer.en: God, please forgive me for the times that I am slow to obey You. Help me to obey You and honor You with my thoughts and actions.
prayer.zh-Hant: 神啊，求祢赦免我遲遲不順服祢的時候。求祢幫助我順服祢，用思想和行動尊榮祢。

content.en:
When your student pastor announces a mission trip out of state, what are your first thoughts? Do you feel excited to get great pictures for your social media account or a joy that you get to serve the Lord and tell others about Him? If you’ve served God only for praise, for an aesthetic picture, or for your own benefit, then you’ve missed out on a much greater blessing.

In this week’s lesson, we read about Jesus healing Peter’s mother-in-law; she then quickly got up to serve others. Why did she start serving with so much urgency? Because she was a child of God! She had experienced His kindness, and in a lost world, she used the gifts God had given her for His glory and to point others to Him. She got up to serve and used what was most natural for her.

Service to the church doesn’t earn you a spot in heaven, but it does glorify God and build the church. If your motivation for serving is selfish, then take a step back, repent of that sin, and begin again. Jesus sacrificed everything so that you can live eternally with Him. Let that be your motivation for using your gifts to serve quickly.
content.zh-Hant:
當你的學生事工牧者宣布到外州進行短宣時，你首先想到甚麼？你是因為能為社交媒體拍美照而興奮，還是因能服事主、向人述說祂而喜樂？如果你服事神只是為了得到稱讚、拍漂亮照片或得到自己的利益，你就錯過了更大的祝福。

在本週課程中，我們讀到耶穌醫治彼得的岳母；她隨即起來服事別人。她為甚麼如此迫切地開始服事？因為她是神的兒女！她經歷了祂的恩慈，並在失喪的世界中運用神所賜的恩賜榮耀祂，帶領別人歸向祂。她起來服事，用她最自然的方式服事。

服事教會不能為你賺取天上的位置，卻能榮耀神、建立教會。如果你服事的動機自私，就停下來，為這罪悔改，重新開始。耶穌犧牲了一切，使你能永遠與祂同活。願這成為你迅速運用恩賜服事的動力。

question.en: What gifts has God given you to serve in the church and outside of the church?
question.zh-Hant: 神賜給你甚麼恩賜，使你能在教會內外服事？

question.en: How can you serve in a new way?
question.zh-Hant: 你可以如何用新的方式服事？

prayer.en: God, thank You for the gifts You have given me for Your glory. Please give me the boldness to serve You in new ways.
prayer.zh-Hant: 神啊，感謝祢賜給我恩賜，使我能榮耀祢。求祢賜我勇氣，以新的方式服事祢。

content.en:
When your coach or teacher orders you around but never sees you or treats you as a real person, how do you feel? Contrast that with someone who has taken time to get to know you and care about you as a person. When they give you an order, are you more likely to obey? The difference between these two reactions? Compassion. Trusting that others have your best interest in their heart is more difficult when they haven’t taken time to know you, to love you, to show you compassion. Someone who has taken time to get to know us has proven that they care about our heart and the outcome of their request. We follow them more easily.

Today’s passage is a reminder that God is compassionate, even though we sin against Him daily. How much love and compassion does He have for you? Verse 12 says that He has thrown out your sins as far as the east is from the west; in other words, He has thrown them out completely. God doesn’t want to simply tell you what you can and cannot do. He cares deeply for you and loves you with a love greater than any earthly father. Did you catch the really cool fact in verse 14? God knows what we’re made of: dust. He remembers we are frail, weak, and vulnerable. He remembers that we are human. And yet, He is compassionate. Let this truth be a reminder to you today that God is more than a list of rules. He is a loving Father, who wants to have a relationship with you and to take care of you. God has proven His love and compassion for you time and time again, but especially in sending His Son for your salvation.
content.zh-Hant:
當教練或老師對你呼來喝去，卻從不留意你，也不把你當作一個真實的人對待時，你有甚麼感受？相比之下，想想花時間認識你、關心你的人。當他們給你指示時，你是否更願意順服？這兩種反應的分別是甚麼？是憐憫。當別人沒有花時間認識你、愛你、向你表達憐憫時，你較難相信他們真心為你著想。花時間認識我們的人已證明，他們關心我們的心，也關心他們要求的結果。我們比較容易跟隨他們。

今天的經文提醒我們，雖然我們每天都得罪神，祂仍然充滿憐憫。祂對你有多少愛和憐憫？第12節說，祂使你的罪離你有東離西那麼遠；換言之，祂完全除去你的罪。神不只是想告訴你甚麼能做、甚麼不能做。祂深深關心你，愛你超過世上任何父親。你留意到第14節很奇妙的一點嗎？神知道我們是甚麼造的：塵土。祂記得我們脆弱、軟弱、容易受傷；祂記得我們是人。然而，祂仍憐憫我們。願這真理今天提醒你：神不只是一套規則。祂是慈愛的父，渴望與你建立關係、照顧你。神一次又一次向你證明祂的愛和憐憫，尤其是差遣祂的兒子來拯救你。

question.en: Is it easy for you to remember God’s love and compassion toward you? Why or why not?
question.zh-Hant: 你容易記得神對你的愛和憐憫嗎？為甚麼？

question.en: You are dust, but God loves you anyway. What does that tell you about His character?
question.zh-Hant: 你是塵土，神卻仍然愛你。這讓你看見祂怎樣的品格？

prayer.en: God, You are so good and kind. Thank You for showing me compassion, and by Your authority, forgiving my sins.
prayer.zh-Hant: 神啊，祢是如此良善仁慈。感謝祢向我施憐憫，並憑祢的權柄赦免我的罪。

content.en:
Have you ever heard someone say, “I made it through the day and never used math once”? The message they are saying is that they learned a skill that was not useful to them and wasted their time in the process. That might be true for some classes you're required to take in your school career, but that is not true for the message of the gospel. The good news of Jesus is not only a story you can tell but a command for all Christians to share as they go through life. We learned this week that God’s authority comes with compassion, and the gifts He has given you are to be used for His glory. Jesus tells us in Matthew how Christians should spread the good news: As you go in your town, your country, and the world, tell people about Jesus. Everywhere you go is a place where people need the message and hope of the gospel.

Why is it important that you share the gospel? The world needs to understand the authority and compassion of God. They need to hear the hope of salvation from sin and eternal separation from God. They need to hear truth. How can the world hear and understand the gospel? According to Jesus, through you. He commands you to tell them. Because you are under the authority of Jesus, the pressure of a perfect delivery of the gospel is off; you only need to be obedient. You only need to go. The Holy Spirit will go with you and equip you. He will open the doors and give you the words to say. Try this today: As you visit a coffee shop or stand in a checkout line, find the people on the fringes who need to hear good news. Sit down with them. Be a friend. Tell them about Jesus and the difference He has made in your life.
content.zh-Hant:
你有沒有聽人說過：『我過了一整天，一次也沒有用到數學』？他們的意思是，自己學了一項沒有用處的技能，過程中浪費了時間。你求學時必修的某些課或許如此，但福音的信息絕非如此。耶穌的好消息不只是一個可以講述的故事，也是一項給所有基督徒的命令，要他們在生活中分享。我們本週學到，神的權柄伴隨著憐憫，而祂賜給你的恩賜要用來榮耀祂。耶穌在馬太福音中告訴我們，基督徒應如何傳揚好消息：無論你到城鎮、國家或世界各地，都要向人講述耶穌。你所到之處，都有人需要福音的信息和盼望。

為甚麼分享福音很重要？世人需要明白神的權柄和憐憫，需要聽見脫離罪和與神永遠隔絕的救恩盼望，也需要聽見真理。世人如何能聽見並明白福音？耶穌說，是透過你。祂吩咐你告訴他們。因為你在耶穌的權柄之下，不必承擔必須完美表達福音的壓力；你只需要順服，只需要去。聖靈會與你同行並裝備你，祂會開門，賜你當說的話。今天試試看：當你到咖啡店或排隊結帳時，留意那些處於邊緣、需要聽見好消息的人。與他們坐下來，成為朋友，告訴他們耶穌，以及祂如何改變你的生命。

question.en: Is sharing the gospel easy or difficult for you to do? Why or why not?
question.zh-Hant: 分享福音對你來說容易還是困難？為甚麼？

question.en: How does knowing that Jesus’s authority help you share the gospel take the pressure off?
question.zh-Hant: 知道耶穌的權柄幫助你分享福音，如何減輕你的壓力？

prayer.en: Thank You for the gospel. Help me to share with the person who needs to hear it today.
prayer.zh-Hant: 感謝祢賜下福音。求祢幫助我今天向需要聽見福音的人分享。
